daily.today_energy: The cosmos is giving you permission to be a little selfish today. Your intuition is basically a cheat code—trust it. Something's shifting beneath the surface, and you're picking up on frequencies others are missing.

daily.career: Your ideas have teeth today. Someone's listening harder than usual, so speak up about that project you've been sitting on. The energy supports you taking up more space professionally.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is all about reclaiming your narrative, Scorpio. You're moving past old patterns and stepping into a version of yourself that actually vibes with who you've become. Trust the metamorphosis happening beneath the surface.
weekly.love: Vulnerability is your superpower right now. Whether you're single or coupled up, let people see the real you—not the guarded version. Authentic connections are brewing, and they're worth the risk of being seen.
weekly.career: Your ideas are magnetic this week. Don't sleep on that project or conversation you've been hesitating about. Your intuition about direction is spot-on, and putting yourself out there professionally opens unexpected doors.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for intentional rest, not just scrolling in bed. Move in ways that feel good—whether that's dancing, walking, or stretching. Mental clarity follows when you actually listen to what your physical self needs.
